tabProjectsTitle: Clone a repo. See what is missing in two seconds.
tabProjectsDesc: Hearth reads your project requirement files statically and compares them with what will actually run when you cd into the folder.
tabProjectsBullet1: Reads .nvmrc, mise.toml, package.json, pyproject.toml, global.json & Compose
tabProjectsBullet2: Installs via your existing manager without switching global defaults
tabProjectsBullet3: Re-scans after setup and separates tool readiness from app dependencies
tabProjectsPlanSummary: 1 step in plan: mise install node@18.20 + local mise.toml

tabDockerTitle: Containers and clusters at native dev speed.

tabDockerBullet1: One-click Colima setup and VM resource tuning
tabDockerBullet2: Unified tables for containers, images, volumes & ports
tabDockerBullet3: Fast client-go Kubernetes with crash diagnostics & logs
tabAiTitle: Unify AGENTS.md, skills, MCP & local spend.
tabAiDesc: Stop hunting through five hidden dotfiles. Inspect every agent config, test MCP servers live, detect plaintext secrets, and track local token spend.
tabAiBullet1: One shared ~/.agents/AGENTS.md symlinked to all agents
tabAiBullet2: Install skills from GitHub catalogs & diff diverging copies
tabAiBullet3: Live MCP probe + local 7/30/90d token & cost breakdown

tabCleanupBullet2: Smart pre-selection separates safe caches from opt-in items
tabCleanupBullet3: Never touches auth tokens, configs, skills, or active SDKs
tabCleanupItem3Sub: docker builder prune · active images kept

tabSetupBullet2: Export your setup as a JSON preset to reuse across machines
tabSetupBullet3: Verifies every tool in a fresh login shell at the end

bentoTitle: Replace half a dozen heavy tools.
bentoSubtitle: Containers, clusters, local databases, ports, AI configs, runtimes, and disk cleanup — all native and fast.
bentoDockerDesc: One-click open-source Colima on macOS or native Docker Engine on Linux. Manage Compose stacks, logs, images, volumes, and VM resources.
bentoK8sDesc: Fast client-go reads, crash diagnostics, live owner logs, port-forward, Secrets, Helm, and local kind clusters.
bentoAiDesc: Unify AGENTS.md across Claude, Codex, Cursor, Copilot & Gemini. Manage MCP, skill catalogs, hooks & local spend.
bentoCleanupDesc: Finds stale node_modules, pnpm stores, Docker caches, Rust/NuGet caches, and safe AI temp caches — never touching auth, configs, or skills.
bentoDbDesc: Install and run PostgreSQL, Redis, MySQL, MariaDB & MongoDB locally or in Docker. Toggle autostart, spot port conflicts, and launch CLI.
bentoShellDesc: Trace which -a across Node, Python, Go, Rust, Java & PHP. Profile slow zsh or PowerShell startup and clean PATH duplicates.
safetySubtitle: Every scan is strictly read-only. Every mutation goes through an explicit plan with exact commands, file diffs, and automatic backups.
safetyRule1Desc: Never runs project scripts, shims, or hidden hooks.
safetyRule2Desc: Touches only its own block; comments out conflicts instead of deleting.
safetyRule3Desc: Failed steps roll back cleanly while keeping what already succeeded.
safetyRule4Desc: No accounts, no cloud sync, secrets masked before caching or export.
safetyDialogSub: Fix shadowed Node.js path in your login shell
safetyNextBody: 1. Copy ~/.zshrc to a timestamped backup   2. Comment line 42 & add mise block   3. Verify in a fresh login shell that node resolves via mise
safetyAppliedBody: Backup saved to ~/.zshrc.hearth-20261123.bak. Verified in a fresh login shell: node resolves to v22.12.0 via mise.
mcpTitle: Give your AI agent eyes on your machine.
mcpDesc: Connect Hearth as a local stdio MCP server in one click. Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor can inspect installed tools, project mismatches, and environment issues — and propose fixes that always require your approval in Hearth.
mcpFootnote: Never exposes secrets, env values, instructions, or arbitrary shell execution.
mcpPlanHint: Waiting for human approval · Diff & backup shown before run
metric1Desc: Built with Go & mygo. Zero Electron, zero Chromium, zero webview.
metric2Desc: Stays quiet and lightweight even with 20+ tools and clusters.
metric3Desc: 100% local, MIT licensed, no cloud sync and no paywalls.
metric4Desc: English, Russian, German, Spanish, French & Simplified Chinese.
installSubtitle: Free, open source, and verified with SHA-256 checksums & GitHub Build Attestations.
installWinMeta: NSIS installer · x64 & ARM64 · User-scope (no UAC)
installLinuxMeta: No sandbox · tar.gz & AUR PKGBUILD included
installTrustBody: Hearth is free open-source software without paid Apple/Windows signing certificates. On macOS use System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway; on Windows click More info → Run anyway.
